subject.title: Chat context popover: show Anthropic plan usage (5h/weekly/credits) instead of meaningless cost on subscription billing

question: Should maintainers close this issue as implemented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102784 while leaving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102807 open for credential-keyed billing attribution, or keep this issue open until that follow-up lands?
rationale: The central UI/provider mapping work is merged on live main, but the issue has a protected label and one part of the expected API-billed-session behavior remains a broader session/usage data-contract decision.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: Treat the merged plan-usage PR as satisfying this issue and keep the credential-keyed attribution work in the dedicated follow-up.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open until the mixed API/subscription attribution follow-up also lands.

options.title: Narrow and relabel
options.body: Retitle or comment to make this issue only about the remaining API-billed-session cost behavior before handing it to the attribution track.

recommendation.title: Close as implemented
recommendation.body: Treat the merged plan-usage PR as satisfying this issue and keep the credential-keyed attribution work in the dedicated follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the merged implementation and the linked attribution follow-up, so he is the best available owner for the close/split choice.
